summary: Issue #19 DSP/SIMD PoC bench: 8 kernels x 9 constructible impl columns x 7 sizes x input variants = 756 cases/run, 2 runs. Env: Windows 11 x64, i9-9900K (AVX2, no AVX-512), 16 cores, rustc 1.99.0, criterion 0.8.2, warm-up 300ms/measure 1s/sample 20

Full 'mise run bench' crashed twice at ~82-85% completion: 'memory allocation of 1048576 bytes failed' -> abort (0xc0000409). Root cause: Windows commit-limit exhaustion under concurrent sibling-agent load (system commit 163.7/183 GB; free physical RAM fine). Mitigation: per-group runs (8 sequential cargo bench -p ruviform-math -- <kernel>); artifacts identical, bounded process lifetime, resumable

Scalar-ratio medians (2-run avg, sizes 256/1024/4096): dot ~8x fearless_avx2/pulp_v3; fir 3.6-5.7x fearless / 2.6-3.7x pulp; biquad ~2.8x fearless / ~1.5x pulp; fade 4-6.7x both; add/scale ~1.2-2x; clamp_unit ~1x except multiversion 7x at 1024; sine ~1.00x all impls (counter-evidence as designed)
multiversion (autovec) fails perf bar: dot ~1.00x, fir 0.69-0.73x REGRESSION vs scalar; good only on add/clamp at some sizes. fearless_fallback and pulp_scalar mostly <=1.0x as expected
Denormal cliffs @1024 (denormal/normal ns): sine ~10x all impls incl scalar; fir 5-32x (fearless_avx2 31.8x worst); biquad 1.6-4.3x; dot ~1.0x no cliff

Dispatch overhead @1024: fearless_dispatched slower than forced fearless_avx2 on elementwise kernels (add 0.62x, scale 0.66x ratio); pulp_dispatched ~= pulp_v3 (~1.0). Small-size regressions <0.9x vs scalar at 64/256: fearless_dispatched add/scale/clamp_unit, pulp_dispatched clamp_unit/64, multiversion fir

2 complete runs x 756 cases, no crashes with per-group execution. Run-to-run |delta| of median_ns: p50=1.8% p90=25.7% max=516.9% (clamp_unit/1024 group-level slowdown in run2; concurrent load noise). Data committed to docs/impl/exp/data/dsp-simd-poc-20261021-0{1,2}.jsonl

Evidence feeds adoption ADR (T7): two-layer structure supported (scalar needed anyway at small sizes); fearless_simd vs pulp both viable perf-wise; multiversion rejected by perf evidence; dot ulp bound provisional 256 (observed 46, contract misfit verified vs f64 truth); AVX-512 unmeasured (host lacks it); denormal policy needed; candidate MSRVs (fearless_simd 1.89, multiversion 1.86, criterion 1.86, pulp undeclared~1.89) exceed workspace 1.85 -> production adoption needs MSRV bump decision

PoC measurement complete: SIMD wins decisively on compute kernels (dot 8x, fir 3-6x, biquad/fade multi-x), parity-to-loss on memory-bound elementwise at small sizes, multiversion autovec insufficient. Raw data + this log are the ADR's evidence base
